Various code changes to ensure POSIX compliance.

The time window feature makes sb-mksep more suitable for production use by requiring
  sustained resource abuse rather than reacting to brief spikes. Works seamlessly with
  all existing modes including aggregate (-a) and test (-t) modes.

The aggregate mode now properly monitors the combined CPU/memory usage of matching
  processes against thresholds, making it useful for managing multi-process applications
  like Chrome or Electron apps. When thresholds are exceeded, the highest resource
  consumers are killed first.

Add parameterized luminance checks and gradient luminance helper

- Add isLight(threshold:) and isDark(threshold:) for custom threshold support
- Add WeightedColor struct for opacity-weighted color pairs
- Add [WeightedColor].weightedLuminance for gradient luminance calculation
- Add [WeightedColor].contrastingColor() for gradient text color selection
- Add 14 new tests covering shadow intensity, corner radius, and luminance
- Update version to 1.5.0
Fix Swift 6 concurrency: add @MainActor to HapticHelper

Add color utilities, haptics, shake detection, and time formatting (v1.4.0)

- Add comprehensive color extensions: luminance, isDark, contrastingColor,
  adjustedBrightness, hex conversion, ResolvedRGBA for efficient blending
- Add HapticHelper with pre-instantiated generators for low-latency feedback
- Add .onShake() modifier for shake gesture detection
- Add .adaptiveInnerBorder() for luminance-aware borders
- Add Int/Double.formattedAsTime for MM:SS duration formatting
- Add 10 new tests for color and time formatting utilities
- Update version to 1.4.0
- Update README and CHANGELOG with merged v1.3.0 and v1.4.0 features
